This website has a new look and a new home. It is now built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published on GitHub Pages.

The publication list is generated directly from the same BibTeX files I use for my CV, so it stays up to date.

New posts will appear here: notes on econometrics, data science, and AI in industry.
